svg.text: Two sources, one priority, and nothing that breaks if you get it wrong
MAINS ADAPTER INPUT — 7 to 24 V, either polarity
opens in 2 µs on a short,
connecting to a live source opens the fuse
instead of destroying the input amplifier
Any combination is allowed: mains adapter alone, USB alone, or both.
Changing from one to the other happens without a break or a restart — you can
unplug the computer mid-session without losing a sample.
